# Model 5 — Decision Tree

A Decision Tree turns prospect characteristics into readable rules. We compare different tree complexity values (`cp`) with 5-fold cross-validation, as in the pruning and `plotcp()` material from class. A simpler tree may generalize better to future draft years.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
dir.create("objects", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
train_x_raw <- readRDS("objects/train_x_raw.rds")
test_x_raw <- readRDS("objects/test_x_raw.rds")
train_y <- readRDS("objects/train_y.rds")
```

```{r analysis}
library(caret)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, classProbs = TRUE)

set.seed(12345)
tree_model <- train(x = train_x_raw, y = train_y, method = "rpart",
                    tuneGrid = expand.grid(cp = c(0.002, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02)),
                    trControl = ctrl, metric = "Kappa")
print(tree_model$results)
print(tree_model$bestTune)
# Plot the final fitted tree, not a tree trained on held-out players.
rpart.plot(tree_model$finalModel, main = "Draft Probability Decision Tree")

tree_prob <- as.numeric(predict(tree_model, test_x_raw, type = "prob")[, "Drafted"])
tree_pred <- factor(ifelse(tree_prob >= 0.5, "Drafted", "Undrafted"),
                    levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted"))

```

```{r save-results, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(tree_model, "objects/tree_model.rds")
saveRDS(tree_model$results, "objects/tree_cv.rds")
saveRDS(tree_prob, "objects/tree_prob.rds")
saveRDS(tree_pred, "objects/tree_pred.rds")
```
